question: Does the frozen applicability-domain detector flag telemetry that is genuinely outside its training distribution? Every number recorded for it until now was in-distribution.
authority: ADR-AIIM-171, criteria fixed before the run
method: Every non-null numeric telemetry feature multiplied by k. k=1 is the negative control. No re-fitting; the registered artifact is loaded and hash-checked. Leakage guard run over the perturbed columns before scoring.

declared_reading.approaches_100pc_by_k10: the detector does what its fail-closed role requires
declared_reading.stays_at_contamination_floor: it cannot distinguish telemetry a thousandfold outside its training range from telemetry inside it; section 2.1's description must be narrowed to what it demonstrably does
